text:
nora: Starting tenant_index backfill btf-451 on prod-shard-5. Requesting lease; will run w/ conservative defaults. @felix pls DB-watch.

deploybot: Lease assigned to runner-5 for job btf-451. config: chunk_size=400, concurrency=2, inter_chunk_sleep=300ms. stall_watch=ON. ETA 18m.

felix: Tail on. Im watching pg_stat_activity + blocking_pids. Will page if any relational lock > 4s against user_index.

kevin: Heads-up: we rolled out v2.16.0 last night; feature flags for tags consumer still on. should be safe but watch index writes.

nora: start command: `./backfill run --job btf-451 --lease runner-5 --safe-mode`

deploybot: Progress 8% -> 22% -> 35%. No alerts.

felix: p95 steady but p99 a little jumpy. seeing occasional 5-7s locks from autovacuum tasks. not from backfill yet.

sre-bot: Observability alert threshold nearing: long_lock_rate=0.6% over 5m. Not firing yet.

nora: Adjusting run live: dropping concurrency -> 1, bumping inter_chunk_sleep -> 600ms. issuing live-config change via deploybot.

deploybot: Live config update accepted. concurrency=1, inter_chunk_sleep=600ms.

felix: After change, p99 latency back down. two brief waits at ~4s, resolved. continuing to monitor.

nora: Good. Keep a tight watch for next 10m. If we exceed 3 long locks in a minute we abort and pin. Abort command is:
```
./deploybot abort --lease runner-5 --reason "excessive locks" --pin v2.16.0
```

kevin: Copy. I'll prepare a release-notes blurb template and attach traces if we abort.

deploybot: ALERT: stall detected at 00:12:14 — long_lock_count=3, longest_lock=9s. Auto-pause pending in 30s unless manual continue is signalled. :warning:

felix: seeing 3 waiters stuck on relation user_index for ~8-9s. This looks like an index vacuum conflict. Requesting graceful pause now.

nora: sending pause: `./backfillctl pause --job btf-451 --grace 20s`

deploybot: Pause acknowledged by 1 of 2 workers, waiting for remaining worker to confirm.

felix: remaining worker hung; not responding to pause. I can try killing its PID to avoid lock escalation but that could leave partial state. thoughts?

kevin: If we can abort cleanly that's safer. We prefer a clean abort and pin to prevent surprise deploys during investigation.

nora: Agreed. Initiating abort now.

deploybot: Abort executed. job btf-451 status=ABORTED. Lease released. Pin applied: platform pinned at v2.16.0 until manual unpin.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0499. Telemetry bundle uploaded. Notifying #eng-oncall.

kevin: Drafting release note: "btf-451 aborted due to index/autovacuum lock escalation; services pinned to v2.16.0; retry planned after vacuum window and config tweaks." Adding abort command + pg snapshots to notes.

felix: Uploaded `pg_stat_activity` + `pg_locks` snapshot and a short flamegraph for the backfill process to the runbook. Propose: next attempt use chunk_size=150, inter_chunk_sleep=1s, concurrency=1, and schedule during low-autovacuum window Sat 02:30-04:30 UTC. Also add a preflight check for active autovacuum workers on target relations.

nora: Sounds good. We'll unpin only after a successful canary run and 24h observation. I'll publish release note and assign follow-ups. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
